event_chain.summary: Unusual server activity; systems taken offline

summary: University Hospitals, a Cleveland-based health system, detected unusual server activity and proactively took digital systems offline on Thursday, October 22, 2026, disrupting MyChart access and website services across its Northeast Ohio facilities. UH said it was investigating with outside experts and had not characterized the activity as a cyberattack, identified ransomware, or said whether patient data was accessed.
